note: Two-sided fixture for the word filter's run-together, leetspeak and diacritic
matching (PLAN-2026-09-14 item 5). ACCEPT cases must match; REJECT cases must
not. A filter without its REJECT half cannot be told apart from an inverted one
(darking, 2026-08-26), so adding only ACCEPT cases is not a change that has been
This file is data on purpose: add a word to mustMatch or mustNotMatch and the
test picks it up with no code change. Fields per case:
text   - what the filter is given, exactly as a person would type it
term   - optional, the dictionary term the match must be reported as
tier   - optional, 'slurs' or 'profanity'; default is both lists at once
locale - optional, overrides the language's reader locale for this case
why   - why this case is here. Cases whose reason names a number came out of
444,028 Portuguese sentences; they are regressions with a measured
locale is the READER's locale, which is what the region-dependent vocabulary is
gated on. null means the region is unknown: global lists only.
